mapper.select: select m.id, m.music_name as musicName, m.album_id as albumId, m.musician_id as musicianId, m.duration, m.cover_url as coverUrl, m.is_vip as isVip, m.status, IFNULL(u.stage_name, '未知音乐人') AS musicianName, IFNULL(a.album_name, '未知专辑') AS albumName, l.updated_time as updatedTime from music as m left join musician u on m.musician_id = u.id left join album a on m.album_id = a.id left join like_record l on m.id = l.target_id where m.id = #{targetId} and l.user_id = #{userId} and l.target_type = 1 and l.is_canceled = 0 GROUP BY m.id

select m.id, m.music_name as musicName, m.album_id as albumId, m.musician_id as musicianId, m.duration, m.cover_url as coverUrl, m.is_vip as isVip, m.status, IFNULL(u.stage_name, '未知音乐人') AS musicianName, IFNULL(a.album_name, '未知专辑') AS albumName, l.updated_time as updatedTime from music as m left join musician u on m.musician_id = u.id left join album a on m.album_id = a.id left join like_record l on m.id = l.target_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and l.target_type = 1 and l.is_canceled = 0 GROUP BY m.id order by l.updated_time desc
SELECT DISTINCT mar.quality_type FROM music_audio_relation mar WHERE mar.music_id = #{musicId} ORDER BY mar.quality_type
